meta.name: MECHFALL // FORGE 77 — full model / trace / 3D mesh library
meta.note: The ONLY allowed full models and traces are the 30 example chassis below. Each is a complete procedural model (20-parameter shape vector + signature-part composition), three INDEPENDENT front / side / top blueprint traces, and a real indexed triangulated 3D part-soup mesh — derived exclusively from that example. No ripped, imported, extracted, traced-from-screenshot or base-mod geometry is used.

policy.note: A chassis is allowed only when its signature-part composition comes from the example library (7 slots / 59 original procedural part types). Generic untyped hulls, numeric-only scaling and any model source outside these 30 examples are rejected. Players still mix example parts freely.

mesh.note: Indexed triangulated part-soup mesh generated only from the example shape vector; no imported geometry.

models.sourceNote: Full model, three independent orthographic traces and a triangulated 3D mesh derived only from example chassis bt7274 (chassis.json roster). No imported mesh, texture or third-party asset.
